Container.Name: B+ Ark Server Controller
Container.Overview: Manage multiple ARK: Survival Ascended dedicated servers from one browser UI. The controller stores shared ARK files once and keeps each server profile's saves, configuration, maps, ports, logs and backups separate.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: ark asa ark survival ascended dedicated server game server controller
Container.Requires: Docker must be enabled. The controller requires the Docker socket so it can create and manage the ARK server containers.
Container.Changes: Initial Community Applications template for B+ Ark Server Controller 1.3.

Config.Name: Controller data
Config.Description: Persistent controller configuration, server registry and per-server settings.

Config.Name: ARK server data
Config.Description: Persistent shared ARK installation, profiles, saves, mods, plugins, logs and backups.

Config.Name: Docker socket
Config.Description: Required so the controller can create and manage ASA server containers. Only use images you trust.
